modern_card.name: Behemoth the King of All Animals

transitions.historical_text: This card can be Normal Summoned or Set with 1 Tribute Monster. In that case, the original ATK of this card becomes 2000. When this card is Tribute Summoned successfully, you can return from your Graveyard to the owner's hand a number of Beast-Type monsters equal to the number of Tributed monsters.
transitions.summary: Era summon-procedure availability, not a text erratum: the GOAT script calls aux.AddNormalSummonProcedure/AddNormalSetProcedure with opt=false and then re-registers the effect as EFFECT_SUMMON_PROC/EFFECT_SET_PROC, which strips the modern gate in aux.NormalSummonCondition1 ('(not opt or (tributes>0 and tributes~=max))', proc_normal.lua:39-50). The era version therefore offers the 1-Tribute/original-ATK-becomes-2000 procedure at any Level (upstream comment: 'Can be summoned with its procedure even if lv6'), while the modern version offers it only when the card's current Level would otherwise demand 2 Tributes, i.e. Level 7 or higher. The Tribute-Summon trigger also differs: goat tests IsSummonType(SUMMON_TYPE_TRIBUTE), modern tests IsTributeSummoned(). No dated source for either difference; chronology unresolved.

effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the PSCT text (SBCB-EN052, Speed Duel: Battle City Box)

transitions.modern_text: You can Normal Summon/Set this card with 1 Tribute, but its original ATK becomes 2000. When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target Beast monsters in your GY equal to the number of monsters Tributed; return them to the hand.
transitions.summary: Wording modernisation only (v1 DR3-EN134 trims 'Tribute Monster'/'successfully', v2 SBCB-EN052 is the PSCT rewrite adding the word 'target'). The 'target' wording is not a targeting change: both scripts use Duel.SelectTarget with a chkc branch and neither script's activation effect gains or loses EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET in the diff.

review.notes: CONFLICT: the pinned modern cards.cdb text matches no lineage version exactly (best match v2 at ratio 0.8296). It ends with '* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.' and says 'return those targets to the hand' where v2 says 'return them to the hand' - i.e. BabelCDB is carrying an unofficial OCG-functionality text rather than the printed TCG text. The historical side is clean: the goat cdb text matches v0 (FET-EN014, 2005-03-01) exactly. Minor secondary script difference not recorded as its own change: at resolution the modern script re-filters the targets by RACE_BEAST while the goat script returns every target still related to the effect, so a target whose Race changed after targeting behaves differently. The rest of the diff (filter rename thfilter->filter, SetRange/SetReset reordering, LOCATION_MZONE|LOCATION_GRAVE vs +) is inert.
